summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K attaching a letter to the Chilean Financial Market Commission regarding a local bond placement. The bank placed Serie FG senior, dematerialized, bearer bonds registered under No. 11/2022, totaling CLF 310,000 (approximately USD 11.4 million based on June 2026 UF rate) with a November 1, 2030 maturity and average placement rate of 2.82%. No special situation event is present; this is a routine debt financing matter. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, buyback, or restructuring activity. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction reported as material information under Chilean securities law.
